requirements_summary:
- Primary workload: low-latency personalization and streaming chat; typical sequences 32-128 tokens.
- Latency targets requested: customer-observed p95 <= 120ms for streaming chat (token latency), server p95 <= 40ms for same path.
- For non-streaming completions: server-side p95 <= 200ms for 512-token outputs (batched).
- Expected concurrency: 2k concurrent sessions, peak throughput ~50k short requests/minute (burst to 80k/min).
- Reliability: 99.95% uptime target for dedicated pool; automatic fallback to compatible model with documented quality delta.
- Observability: need per-request token timing, sample traces (jaeger), and cost per-token reports.
- Measurement alignment: require both client-side SDK hooks + server timing headers; define measurement window (24h with 1-min aggregation) and percentile calc method (HDR histogram recommended).
po_notes: Procurement: wants SLA draft with explicit p95/p99 definitions + cap on financial penalties. Legal asked for example incident playbook. Budget hold until vendor certs confirmed.
technical_notes:
- Suggest 6 GPUs (A100-equivalent) for baseline reserved run with continuous batching tuned to avg seq len 64.

- Plan: provide sample client instrumentation (JS + Go) that emits x-rwd-sent/x-rwd-first-token headers and a small sidecar to compute client-observed percentiles.
